deposits.genre_observed: genre formalization / executive summary of Effective Acts

finds.quote: **Mechanism 2: Modeling Possibility.** Effective Acts demonstrate that the declaration *can be made*. Before Ginsberg, no one had spoken the end of the war as a poetic act. After Ginsberg, the form exists. Others can use it.
finds.note: Literary-historical priority thesis: Ginsberg's line as first instance of the form and prototype of the genre; argued as the deposit's own genealogy, not reported scholarship.

finds.quote: **Not metaphor** — Ginsberg did not mean the war ended "poetically" or "spiritually." He meant the war ended.
finds.note: Thesis about what an author meant by a passage (authorial intent of Ginsberg's declaration); contestable by evidence about Ginsberg.

finds.quote: Core claim: Revelation was written first (68-73 CE). The Cosmic Christ appears first — not as capstone but as seed kernel. The Gospels and Epistles are algorithmic derivations from the originary image.
finds.note: Revelation-first chronology of the New Testament, with a date window; stated as the room's core claim (argued at length in the Revelation Room anchor, 10.5281/zenodo.18380933).

finds.quote: Fragment 31: κῆνος ("that man") is not the rival but the placeholder — the position of the future reader. Sappho's poem addresses *you* across 2,600 years; the "man who sits opposite her" is whoever reads.
finds.note: Thesis about what Sappho 31's κῆνος originally meant/what position the poem constructs; an interpretive-historical claim contested against the rival reading.

deposits.genre_observed: position paper / forensic study of an AI Overview session

finds.quote: **No prior literary work has demonstrated sustained, architecture-aware traversal by a general-purpose AI summarizer, at public scale, in an open web environment, without bespoke tooling or privileged integration.**
finds.falsifier_quote:
A counterexample would need to show:

- Independent AI summarizer traversal (not fine-tuned or privileged)
- Preservation of internal architectural distinctions
- Stable ontology across multiple queries
- Depth-gate propagation rather than terminal summary
- Operator-level behavior (not just accurate description)
finds.note: Uncertain fit: a literary-historical negative-priority claim (no prior work achieved this) argued with comparative cases (§2.2-2.3) and falsification criteria; the first reading may already hold it as G or D.

finds.quote:
The Poet was liquidated by:

  1. **The MFA Industrial Complex** -- identity-ification, workshop circuits, craft-as-metric, the poet as demographic
  2. **The Capture of the Avant-Garde** -- tenure as domestication, criticality as style, Language Poetry's institutional absorption
  3. **Platform Enclosure** -- the feed, the post, the engagement metric, the dissolution of durational time into content
finds.note: Thesis about recent literary history (the 'Poet' function liquidated by MFA programmes, the absorption of the avant-garde, platform enclosure); stated as the deposit's own diagnosis and not argued at length — borderline.

close reading of its own title / effective act

finds.quote: English lost the aorist. The Germanic drift collapsed aspectual richness into tense poverty. We kept only present and past. Every completion became indexed: "I called" (when?), "I have called" (still relevant how?). The non-indexed perfective — completion without temporal anchoring — became structurally unavailable.
finds.note: Historical-linguistic thesis advanced as the deposit's own (English lost the aorist through Germanic drift); evidence could confirm or refute it.
